Irelia

the Blade Dancer
Mid laneTop lane

Top lane is Irelia's main role: about 63% of her games are here. On the top island she's a lane bully who dashes through minion waves, wins long trades with a stacked passive, and takes over side lanes with split pushing. She's hard to master but can take over games on her own.

When to pick Irelia

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Better as a counter-pick: tanks and crowd-control champions like Malphite and Jax can shut her down.

Pick into

  • Ranged top laners with no sustain, like Jayce
  • Weak early champions who scale, like Gnar
  • Squishy top laners she can all-in at level 2
  • Teams that can't stop a split pusher

Avoid into

  • Tanky champions with armor and crowd control, like Malphite
  • Champions who block autos or out-sustain her, like Jax and Warwick
  • Teams with lots of point-and-click crowd control
  • Lanes where the enemy can keep the wave small

Great teammates

Lee SinStrong early ganks help you snowball your lane.
NautilusHis crowd control lets you dive freely in teamfights.
OriannaHer shield and ultimate combo with your dashes into the enemy team.

Your team needs: Pick Irelia top when your team can play around a split pusher and has some crowd control for teamfights.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Excellent dueling power once her passive is stacked
  • Bladesurge resets make her one of the most mobile top laners
  • Strong split pusher who can beat most opponents one-on-one
  • Defiant Dance blocks a lot of physical damage from AD top laners

Weaknesses

  • Weak when the enemy wave is small: no minions means no Q resets
  • Struggles against tanks and champions with point-and-click crowd control
  • Missing your E stun loses most trades
  • Gets countered hard by champions who punish dashes

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Q + E is a deadly all-in on the top island
  • Level 6: R gives you a ranged engage and extra marks
  • First item (Blade of The Ruined King): you win most duels
  • Two items (Hullbreaker): a huge split-pushing spike
  • Three items (Wit's End): magic resist and attack speed to beat AP and tanky threats

Top tips

  • Stack passive on minions before every trade
  • Use W to block physical burst from top lane fighters
  • Take Ignite: your top quest gives you Unleashed Teleport anyway
  • Fight when the enemy wave is bigger than yours
  • Freeze near your tower when you're ahead
  • Split push after your first two items
  • Avoid long trades with tanks: you'll lose them
